title: The kb's own clone reads ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} unsubstituted in its linked sprint skills and worker file, and the absolute commands it then writes match no allow rule
goal: In a kb clone without the plugin, the sprint, item and backlog skills and the worker role file give commands its .claude/settings.json allow rules match (the relative python3 _tools/... form where the variable is not substituted), and selfcheck allow-rules reads the text the skills hold

run: import sys; t=open('agents/worker.md').read(); sys.exit(1 if 'python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/_tools/backlog.py' in t and 'python3 _tools/backlog.py' not in t else 0)

repro_reason: the substitution happens only in a Claude Code session; the review read the skill and settings text
notes: Review gaps 2 and 3: skills/*/SKILL.md line 8 says to write the clone's top directory where the variable shows; .claude/settings.json allows Bash(python3 _tools/backlog.py *), which an absolute path does not match; bl_selfcheck.SKILL_COMMANDS holds only the relative form; agents/worker.md:10 defines the variable only where the brief names the directory, and the kb's brief names none.
